retrievalProfile.description: A tight, intimate close-up portrait of a mature artist set against a dark, textured wall with clean, modern sans-serif typography positioned in the lower-left quadrant.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned close-up of a man's face occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, looking directly at the camera. The left third features a dark, horizontally-textured wall that serves as a canvas for minimalist white and blue text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's eyes align with the upper horizontal third line
Text is anchored to the lower-left shoulder area
Warm skin tones contrast against a cool, dark textured background
Tight cropping creates a sense of proximity and intimacy
coreInvariants: Horizontal texture on the background wall

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's head is large-scale, positioned off-center to the right, with the top of the hair slightly cropped.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's bright blue eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer starts at the eyes, moves down to the mouth, then follows the shoulder line to the text in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, textured area on the left provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the hair, clothing, and background shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm peach and tan skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for primary text and a muted cyan for secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the skin/text and the dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones and monochromatic text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and color contrast within the same typeface family or similar geometric skeletons.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric uppercase look with varying weights.
Classic geometric sans-serif that matches the circular 'O' and sharp 'M'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a mature man with dark hair and blue eyes, positioned on the right side of the frame. The background should be a dark, horizontally-textured plaster or concrete wall. Lighting should be warm and soft on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned uppercase text in the lower-left area. The top line should be large, white, and medium weight. The bottom line should be smaller, light blue, and have wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the subject's face off-center to the right?
Is the background dark and textured?
Is the primary text white and the secondary text blue?
Is the typography a clean, geometric sans-serif?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the specific individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure vital facial features
Check that the background texture is visible but not distracting
Verify the hierarchy between the two lines of text
Confirm the warm/cool color balance between skin and background
recipe.reuseFormula: Close-up Portrait + Textured Wall + Lower-Left Geometric Typography
